account_status_code_sent: A new code is on its way.
common_app_tagline: Learn to read Japanese by typing it.
leaderboards_badges_description: Members can wear it on their card.
leaderboards_create_group_description: A board for a class or friends, for as long as you like.
leaderboards_create_marathon_description: A race with a start and an end. Everyone starts from zero.
leaderboards_following_empty: Share your username, or follow someone by theirs.
leaderboards_following_error_load: Could not load who you follow. Check your connection.
leaderboards_following_error_unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
leaderboards_following_rename_descriptio: People find you by this name.
leaderboards_following_rename_error_inva: That will not work. Use 3 to 20 letters, digits, - or _.
leaderboards_following_signed_out: Sign in to compare your score with people you follow.
leaderboards_global_empty: Nobody is on the global board yet.
leaderboards_global_join_description: You are not on the global board. Anyone can see who is on it, so you are only there if you choose to be.
leaderboards_groups_create_description: Everyone in a group sees the same board. You can invite people once it exists.
leaderboards_groups_create_hint: Up to 40 characters. Everyone in the group sees it.
leaderboards_groups_delete_description: The board goes for everyone in it, and its invite and display links stop working. Nobody loses their own progress.

leaderboards_groups_empty: Nobody else yet. Invite people with the button above.
leaderboards_groups_error_expired: This invite has ended. Ask for a new one.
leaderboards_groups_error_invalid: That will not work. Use 1 to 40 characters.
leaderboards_groups_error_limit: That is the most groups you can be in, or the group is full.
leaderboards_groups_error_load: Could not load this board. Check your connection.
leaderboards_groups_error_not_found: This invite does not work. Check the link, or ask for a new one.
leaderboards_groups_invite_description: Scan the code, send the link, or type the code under it in Add group.
leaderboards_groups_invite_label_qr: QR code with the invite link
leaderboards_groups_invite_off: Invites are off, so nobody new can join.
leaderboards_groups_join_description: Everyone in the group sees each other's name and score on one board.
leaderboards_groups_join_error_code: That isn't an invite code. It has 8 letters and numbers.
leaderboards_groups_leave_description: You go off the board. To come back you need a new invite.
leaderboards_groups_remove_description: They go off the board and are not told. They can come back with an invite link that still works.
leaderboards_groups_screen_description: Open this link on the computer connected to the screen. It shows the board full screen and keeps it up to date, without signing in.
leaderboards_groups_screen_off: The screen link is off, so nothing shows the board.
leaderboards_groups_screen_warning: Anyone with this link sees everyone's name and score.
leaderboards_groups_settings_hint_member: Only you can change or stop the link.
leaderboards_scan_error_blocked: The camera is blocked. Allow it for yomukana in your settings.
leaderboards_scan_error_unknown: The camera didn't start. Close this and try again.
marathon_board_counting_hint: Read on more than one device? Open yomukana on each, so everything you read before the end counts.
marathon_board_empty: Nobody is running yet. Share the invite.
marathon_create_description: Everyone starts reading from zero at the start. Whoever has read furthest by the end wins.
marathon_create_error_far: It can start 3 months from now at the latest.
marathon_create_error_long: It can run for 3 months at most.
marathon_create_error_order: It has to end after it starts.
marathon_create_error_past: It can't start in the past.
marathon_create_error_short: It has to run for at least a day.
marathon_create_hint_late: They start from zero, later than everyone else.
marathon_create_hint_name: Up to 40 characters. Everyone in it sees it.
marathon_create_hint_results: Until then, a phone that was offline at the end can still send what it read before. An hour covers most, and the results are still in the same evening.
marathon_create_hint_running: You're on the board and start from zero, like everyone else.
marathon_create_hint_times: Your time zone, {zone}. Everyone else sees it in theirs.
marathon_create_label_late: People can join after it starts
marathon_delete_description: The board and everything read in it go for everyone, and its links stop working. Nobody loses their own reading.
marathon_error_expired: Running in it is closed. You can still watch.
marathon_error_forbidden: Only the organiser can change that.
marathon_error_invalid: That will not work. Check the name and the times.
marathon_error_limit: That is the most marathons you can be in, or this one is full.
marathon_error_not_found: This marathon does not exist any more, or the link is wrong.
marathon_invite_description: Scan the code, send the link, or type the code under it. Everyone chooses to run or to watch.
marathon_invite_off: Invites are off, so nobody new can join.
marathon_join_closed: Running in it is closed, but you can watch.
marathon_join_fresh: Everyone starts from zero. Your own reading stays as it is.
marathon_join_public: Your name and score are shown to everyone in it.
marathon_leave_description: Your reading in it is deleted, and you come off its board. Your own reading stays as it is.
marathon_over_description_counting: You're {place} for now. Final results at {when}.
marathon_settings_hint_times: Can be moved until it starts. Your time zone, {zone}.
marathon_started_description: Everyone starts from zero, so the first sentences are easy. Your streak counts either way.
profile_view_error_load: Could not load this profile. Check your connection.
profile_view_missing_description: Nobody is called @{username}. Names have to match exactly.
prompt_install_description: It opens like an app and works without a connection.
prompt_install_title: Put yomukana on your home screen
prompt_notify_description: A reminder in the evening, only if you haven't read yet.
prompt_signup_card_description: A page with your score and streak, to show anyone.
prompt_signup_friends_description: Follow friends and see how your scores compare.
prompt_signup_groups_description: Make a group, share a code, and everyone reads on one board.
prompt_signup_seals_description: Reach milestones and wear what you earn on your card.
prompt_signup_sync_description: Read on your laptop, carry on on your phone. Nothing is lost if this browser forgets.
push_reminder_body_streak: Read 5 sentences to keep your {days}-day streak.
push_test_body: This is how yomukana reminds you.
seal_classic_days: Gathering all the rains of early summer, how swift the Mogami River runs.
seal_classic_followers: So many things they bring to mind, the cherry blossoms.
seal_classic_invited: Friends coming from far away: is that not a joy?
seal_classic_joined: A journey of a thousand miles begins beneath your feet.
seal_classic_perfect: Coming out onto the shore at Tago, I see the high white peak of Fuji, and snow still falling on it.
seal_classic_sentences: Japanese poetry takes the human heart as its seed, and grows into countless leaves of words.
seal_classic_streak: Skinny frog, don't give up! Issa is right here.
seal_classic_years: The months and days are travellers of a hundred ages, and the years that come and go are travellers too.
seal_meaning_invited_one: Someone joined a group you run
seal_poem_days_10: Ten days. The desk has learned your name.
seal_poem_days_100: A hundred days given. This is how water wears through stone.
seal_poem_days_1000: A thousand days, and time flows round you like a river round a rock.
seal_poem_days_30: Thirty days, and the reading carries itself.
seal_poem_days_365: A year of days, written in the margins of your calendar.
seal_poem_days_730: Two years. Your days have become a history.
seal_poem_followers_1: Someone is watching the blossoms open.
seal_poem_followers_10: Ten have gathered under your tree.
seal_poem_followers_100: A hundred. You shine, and people turn towards it.
seal_poem_followers_25: Twenty-five pairs of eyes, searching the sky for you.
seal_poem_followers_5: Five know you at a glance.
seal_poem_followers_50: Fifty. Petals fall wherever you walk.
seal_poem_invited_1: Someone came in through your door.
seal_poem_invited_10: Ten followed the wind you sent out.
seal_poem_invited_100: A hundred. You carry the invitation like a banner.
seal_poem_invited_25: Twenty-five. A circle is a kind of home.
seal_poem_invited_5: Five at your table. The room grows warmer.
seal_poem_invited_50: Fifty found their way by your light.
seal_poem_joined: Every path starts somewhere. Yours started in {month}.
seal_poem_perfect_10: Ten without a slip. Clean as the first snow.
seal_poem_perfect_100: A hundred without a flaw. Nothing gets past you.
seal_poem_perfect_1000: A thousand without a mistake. Clear as ice.
seal_poem_perfect_10000: Ten thousand without a flaw. Jade like that, the old story says, was worth fifteen cities.
seal_poem_perfect_5000: Five thousand, perfect. The hand of a master.
seal_poem_sentences_10: Ten sentences. Every library begins with a single page.
seal_poem_sentences_100: A hundred sentences, and the next one is already calling.
seal_poem_sentences_1000: A thousand sentences. Words fall like leaves, and you catch them.
seal_poem_sentences_10000: Ten thousand. You keep a whole room of words.
seal_poem_sentences_100000: A hundred thousand sentences. A forest of the leaves of words.
seal_poem_sentences_2500: Two and a half thousand. The characters have started to answer.
seal_poem_sentences_25000: Twenty-five thousand. The shelves are inside you now.
seal_poem_sentences_5000: Five thousand sentences. Quiet, and knowing.
seal_poem_sentences_50000: Fifty thousand. Old stories trust you with their keeping.
seal_poem_streak_100: A hundred days, and it spreads to everything you touch.
seal_poem_streak_1000: A thousand days. Dragons are born from less.
seal_poem_streak_14: Two weeks in, and the coals stay warm between the days.
seal_poem_streak_200: Two hundred days of heat. Nothing here is cold any more.
seal_poem_streak_3: Three small sparks, and something caught.
seal_poem_streak_30: A month of fire. It no longer needs you to watch it.
seal_poem_streak_365: The seasons turned all the way round, and the flame never went out.
seal_poem_streak_500: Five hundred days. Whatever burned has risen again.
seal_poem_streak_60: Sixty days. The fire has a life of its own now.
seal_poem_streak_7: A week of evenings, every one of them lit.
seal_poem_streak_730: Two years of daylight. You are the fire now.
seal_poem_years_1: One year. The mountain is taller than you thought, and you are higher up it.
seal_poem_years_10: Ten years. The mountain remembers you.
seal_poem_years_2: Two years of seasons, climbed one at a time.
seal_poem_years_3: Three years. You know every path up this hill.
seal_poem_years_5: Five years. The young ones ask you the way.
session_score_change_image_alt: A cat looking up with big, sorry eyes
session_score_change_kept: Nothing you learned is gone. Keep practising and it climbs again.
session_score_change_what: I changed how the score works, so your number looks different now.

session_typing_hint_reading: Up arrow or click for the reading
session_typing_hint_reading_touch: Tap the word for its reading
session_typing_warning_unsaved: Your browser is not storing progress, so this session will be forgotten.
session_welcome_how: Type the sound of each character.
session_welcome_stuck: New to Japanese? Miss twice and it shows you.
settings_data_description: Everything you type stays in this browser unless you turn on sync. Nothing else is sent anywhere.
settings_delete_description: This deletes every character you have learned and every sentence you have read. There is no copy anywhere else, so it cannot be undone. Export first if you want to keep it.
settings_delete_description_synced: This deletes every character you have learned and every sentence you have read, on this device and in the synced copy. It cannot be undone. Your account stays, with nothing in it. Export first if you want to keep it.
settings_delete_done: Every character you had learned and every sentence you had read is gone.
settings_delete_error_sync: Could not reach the server, so nothing was deleted. Try again when you are online.
settings_install_description: Open yomukana from your home screen, like any other app.
settings_install_home_screen: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
settings_install_unavailable: yomukana is installed already, or this browser does not offer to install it.
settings_notifications_description: A reminder when your streak is waiting, and nudges from friends.
settings_notifications_error_denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings.
settings_notifications_error_service: This browser's push service is off. In Brave, turn on "Use Google services for push messaging" in its privacy settings.
settings_notifications_hint_install: On iPhone and iPad, install yomukana first.
settings_notifications_signed_out: Sign in to get reminders and nudges.
settings_notifications_status_test: Sent. If nothing shows up, check this site's notification setting on your device.
settings_notifications_status_test_faile: Your browser's push service did not take it. Turn notifications off and on again on this device.
settings_profile_badges_description: Wear up to 3, badges or seals. Boards show the first one.
settings_profile_badges_empty: None of your groups has a badge yet. A group's admin can make one in its settings.
settings_profile_badges_error_load: Could not load your badges. Check your connection.
settings_profile_badges_error_save: Could not save that. Check your connection.
settings_profile_badges_hint_full: Take one off to wear another.
settings_profile_description_listed: Anyone can see your card and score there, and find you by your name.
settings_profile_error_invalid: That will not work. Use up to 32 characters.
settings_profile_error_load: Could not load your profile. Check your connection.
settings_profile_error_offensive: That name is not allowed. Try another.
settings_profile_hint_display_name: Shown instead of your username. Up to 32 characters.
settings_profile_label_listed: Show me on the global leaderboard
settings_profile_label_qr: QR code with the link to your profile
settings_profile_share_description: Anyone with this link sees your card and score.
settings_profile_signed_out: Your profile comes with an account: a username people can follow you by.
settings_sync_description: Sign in to keep your progress on more than one device. It is then copied to a server in Frankfurt, tied to your email. Without an account, nothing leaves this browser.
settings_sync_error_expired: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again to keep syncing.
settings_sync_error_failed: Could not reach the server. Your progress is safe here and syncs next time.
stats_detail_chart_label: Recognition time by day. Lower is faster.
stats_detail_empty: You have not read this one yet.
stats_empty_description: Read a few sentences and your reading speed will show up here.
stats_grid_legend: Each box fills up with how fast you read that character. Read it right and the clock stops at your first key. Get it wrong and it runs until you get it right.
stats_page_description: How fast you recognise each character, and what still slows you down.
stats_score_chart_label: Your score, sentence by sentence, since you started.
stats_words_description: Words you have read in kanji, slowest first.
stats_words_empty: Kanji stay hidden until your kana is solid. Once they start appearing, the words you read show up here.
stats_words_empty_open: Kanji have started appearing, but you have not read one yet. The next sentence with one will put it here.
streak_freeze_description_one: It saves your streak on a day you miss.
streak_freeze_description_two: You hold 2 now. Each one saves a day you miss.
streak_label_freezes_held: Freezes: {held} of {max}. How to earn one
streak_saved_description: You missed a day, and your {days}-day streak is still going.
streak_started_description: Read 5 sentences tomorrow to keep it going.
streak_stats_hint_freezes: 25 sentences in a day, or 7 days in a row, earns one. You can hold 2.
streak_week_description: You earned a streak freeze for it.
